title: Grateful Dead Live at Ice Palace on 1969-03-29
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with a phenomenal Dark Star that dominates an otherwise solid 1969 performance
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced soundboard capture is praised as crystal‑clear and “ridiculously good” for a 1969 show, making the music come alive. While most listeners rave about the soaring Dark Star and overall fire of the band, one reviewer notes Jerry’s vocals were off‑key, though his lead work still shines. The consensus is that the recording quality elevates an already strong performance.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are highly positive, highlighting both superb soundboard fidelity and a standout Dark Star; only one mixed review tempers the score, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the 1969 sound “ridiculously good,” crisp and well‑balanced; no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is anchored by an epic Dark Star that serves as the high point, with the rest of the performance maintaining a lively, fire‑filled energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads are universally praised as phenomenal; vocal performance is split – some call it perfect, others note off‑key or strained singing.
